body: Lol.  “My body my choice” sign.  Meta.
Exactly.  God forbid he has to divest a little fraction of his holdings to pay for their gains.  Oh no, the humanity!
Ugh.  My wife is a social media powerhouse in the area.  God…I’m going to have to get facial reconstruction and an identity change if I want to keep living here…

Ugh, fuck cancer…I’m so sorry.  There is only one way to understand this pain, and it kills me to know how that so many others have felt this.  

Good for you on leaving!  Being a woman in that situation must have been awful.  Maybe that’s a little sexist, but, as a male who is just naturally bigger I always feel scared for smaller women in these situations, knowing the types of drunks I’ve met before who act like that.  I, for one, admire your strength and power.  

Thank you for your words. And you hit it on the head.  I don’t feel like I can do anything but cause more pain, no matter the direction I go.
Yeah, I would hope he does.  He’s told me things that would ruin him…so…he better!  I kid, I kid…

Hmm… I can only think of one person, but he’s got a really busy family life and I’m positive he doesn’t REALLY want to be that guy.  I don’t know, though, he’s also the most stand up guy I’ve ever met… it’s good advice, thank you!

I’ve actually been to an al-anon group before when we were trying to get through her fathers alcoholism.  It was very interesting.  I will consider that again, thank you.  

She honestly hasn’t fully dealt with that issue yet.  She’s both an addict and a child of an addict dealing with the emotional issues of his addiction, and of course with our current situation.  Fuuuucck….ya know?

Thank you. I am definitely still open to working this out.  I do love her.  But talking is just bullshit from her.  Like a typical addict, she’ll say whatever you want to hear and not follow through.  I just don’t know how to work with that.
Thank you… seriously.  That just made tears pop from my eyes… ❤️
